name: Formal Constraint System Certificate
description: We frame the problem as finding a contradictory subset of formal scheduling constraints. By replacing the explicit arithmetic limits (e.g., p1+p2 > T) with descriptions of contradictory constraint subsets (e.g., the non-preemption and sequence constraints for a single job), the model must deduce that these correspond to the sum of a job's phases exceeding T, or the sum of a machine's processing times exceeding T. This forces algorithmic reasoning to translate the formal system into the simple arithmetic checks.
